title: Chapter 183 The World-Destroying Catastrophe Bell
content:
Chapter 183 The World-Destroying Catastrophe Bell

I don’t know how long it took.

The second thunder tribulation finally dissipated.

However, before everyone could breathe a sigh of relief.

The next thunder tribulation followed closely, leaving no chance for people to react.

Boom!

Suddenly, the entire void began to tremble.

At this moment, everyone truly realized how insignificant they were.

Facing the terrifying heavenly tribulation, everyone didn’t even have the slightest thought of resisting.

However, in the void, Yan Lingyun gritted her teeth and let the terrifying heavenly tribulation pour down on her body.

And at this moment, Lu Daosheng’s face suddenly changed below.

“Not good!”

Lu Daosheng shouted inwardly and quickly took action.

Buzz——

Suddenly, an illusory barrier enveloped the entire void.

Everyone was puzzled, but when they looked at the void again, only a hazy thing was left.

The barrier had no effect on the heavenly tribulation.

At this time, the beautiful scenery inside the barrier was unparalleled.

Yan Lingyun's clothes had long been burned by the heavenly tribulation, revealing a spring scene.

No wonder Lu Daosheng was so anxious.

Below, Lu Daosheng looked at the sky with a frown.

"Damn God, you'd better not be careful, otherwise, "

Lu Daosheng didn't finish his words, but the threatening aura continued to slowly overflow from his body.

Finally, the third thunder tribulation dissipated.

"This time, it should be gone, right?"

Everyone looked at the void, their expressions extremely cautious.

However, three thunder tribulations are not the limit of this world.

Since Yan Lingyun wanted to break the rules, how could it be so simple.

Boom!

A deafening explosion sounded throughout the Xuanling Star Region.

I saw that the thunder tribulation, which was several times more powerful than the previous three, fell down.

"Ah!!"

This time, Yan Lingyun couldn't bear it anymore and screamed in pain.

"Lingyun..."

Looking at Yan Lingyun's painful appearance, Lu Daosheng could only worry below, but could do nothing.

Yan Lingyun's own tribulation, naturally, can only be overcome by herself.

If he goes up to help, it will only be counterproductive.

At this time, Yan Lingyun's face in the void was ugly.

This heavenly tribulation really spared no effort.

This is not the first time she has overcome the tribulation.

But this time, it was more terrifying than the tribulation she had overcome before.

Above the sky, the terrifying tribulation cloud was still pouring down.

The entire void was completely transformed into a sea of thunder.

Crack~

A shattering sound came from the void.

That was the sound of the body breaking.

At this moment, Yan Lingyun was extremely uncomfortable, with dense cracks all over her body.

The body had obviously reached its limit.

However, the heavenly tribulation above the sky did not end, and Yan Lingyun had no chance to breathe at all.

Boom!

Three consecutive terrifying thunderbolts blasted straight down towards Yan Lingyun.

With a loud bang, Yan Lingyun's body shattered.

"Lingyun!"

Seeing this, Lu Daosheng's pupils shrank slightly.

At this moment, Yan Lingyun was left with only an illusory soul standing in the void.

Sensing Lu Daosheng's cry, Yan Lingyun looked down and then smiled.

Seeing this, Lu Daosheng calmed down a little.

"Dad, is my mother really okay?"

Lu Xue shook Lu Daosheng's arm, staring at the void.

But Lu Daosheng was silent for a rare time.

It is almost impossible to resist the terrifying baptism of the heavenly tribulation with just the power of the soul.

Unless it is a strong man who specializes in the power of the soul.

But Yan Lingyun is obviously not.

What should I do?

Lu Daosheng slowly clenched his fists, and a mysterious power slowly permeated from his fists.

As long as there is a slight accident, Lu Daosheng will attack.

Although it will affect Yan Lingyun's future.

But if an accident really happens, Yan Lingyun will have no future at all.

Lu Daosheng can't care so much.

At that time, Lu Daosheng can lift the entire sky.

At the same time, in the deserted city.

Everyone looked at the void with a blank look.

I thought three thunder tribulations were the limit.

Unexpectedly, there were six.

That's six.

According to records, the highest number of thunder tribulations is three, and these six are a bit too terrifying.

Ordinary strong men only have one tribulation.

"Absolutely no more, absolutely no more."

An old man stood on the roof and said repeatedly.

Everyone nodded in agreement when they heard it.

There are already six thunder tribulations, and it would be impolite to come again.

Some strong men looked up and saw that the terrifying tribulation cloud had begun to gradually decrease.

Seeing this, everyone breathed a sigh of relief.

It seems that there is really no more.

In the deserted city, most of the strong men are not there because of the retreat of Huang Shou and others, so there are very few people who can really see through it.

And outside the deserted city, a large number of strong men have gathered at this moment, and they have come to watch this battle against the heavens.

The female emperor of the Divine Dynasty is going through the tribulation.

In the void, Yan Lingyun took a deep breath and looked up at the sky with a solemn expression.

The terrifying tribulation cloud is shrinking, but it is not dissipating, but condensing.

At this moment, Yan Lingyun can clearly feel a strong sense of locking.

"If you want to stop me so much, then come on!"

Yan Lingyun's eyes are cold, staring at the terrifying tribulation cloud.

Dong——

At this time, a bell sounded from the calamity cloud, and it spread all over the world!

Everyone felt a fear from the depths of their souls.

"That, that is..."

An old man with a strong aura looked at the sky and slowly collapsed on the ground.

"No, impossible, impossible!"

I saw a huge bell emitting a destructive aura slowly emerging from the calamity cloud.

It was condensed by the thunder calamity.

"Fuck, the end of the world, the end of the world!"

The huge calamity bell almost enveloped the entire deserted city. For a time, the entire deserted city fell into panic.

"Damn it."

In the city lord's mansion, Lu Daosheng gritted his teeth.

Even he didn't expect that this thing would appear in the calamity of his wife's ascension to immortality.

On the side, Lu Xue hugged Lu Daosheng tightly and couldn't say a word.

"Lingyun, you must hold on."

Originally, Lu Daosheng was 50% sure that Yan Lingyun could hold on, but now, Lu Daosheng is less than 20% sure.

The World-Destroying Tribulation Bell!

This is a terrifying thing that only appears when a world wants to kill something.

What did his wife do to cause the will of this world to target her so much?

Lu Daosheng was puzzled, but at this moment, it was obviously too late to investigate this matter.

Dong——

The terrifying bell sounded again.

In the void, Yan Lingyun's soul body was already shaking violently.

Bang!

The Tribulation Bell fell, completely enveloping Yan Lingyun.

At the same time, screams rang out from inside, which was extremely creepy.

Listening to the shrill screams, Lu Xue's face turned pale, and white tears kept flowing from the corners of her eyes.

"Dad,"

At this time, Lu Daosheng stared at the sky with murderous intent.

After this matter is over, no matter what the outcome is, Lu Daosheng will definitely ask for an explanation from the will of the world.

In the Tribulation Bell, no one noticed that a faint light suddenly bloomed from the depths of Yan Lingyun's soul.

It was a bead that exuded a strange aura.
